 "rationale": "NMOS pair suits VCM=0.9 V (Vth~0.63 V, tail node ~0.35 V). PMOS-mirror load sets the first-stage output near VDD-VSG, which biases the matched PMOS CS stage without systematic offset. A small inverter gives rail-to-rail output. Budget assumes IREF=10 uA: 10 + 4 (tail) + 5 (CS) = 19 uA, about 34 uW. Delay is dominated by the CS pull-down slewing the small inverter gate cap, about 2 ns."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wb":   (2.5, 1.5, 6.0),    # bias diode W (L=Lb), carries IREF
    "Wt":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # tail W -> Itail = IREF*Wt/Wb
    "Wsk":  (1.25, 0.6, 2.5),   # 2nd-stage sink W -> I2 = IREF*Wsk/Wb
    "Lb":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Win":  (4.0, 1.5, 10.0),   # input pair W (L=Lin)
    "Lin":  (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wl":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),    # PMOS mirror load W (L=Lp)
    "Lp":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Wn_inv": (1.0, 0.42, 3.0), # output inverter (L=0.15)
    "Wp_inv": (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Lb, Lin, Lp = p["Lb"], p["Lin"], p["Lp"]
    itail = iref * p["Wt"] / p["Wb"]
    i2 = iref * p["Wsk"] / p["Wb"]
    # PMOS CS matched in current density to the mirror load (no systematic offset)
    W5 = p["Wl"] * i2 / (itail / 2.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF flows from VDD into ibias -> NMOS diode
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb"], Lb)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wt"], Lb)
    # input pair (diode side on vinp -> output y rises when vinp > vinn)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    n.M("M2", "y", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    n.M("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wl"], Lp)
    n.M("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wl"], Lp)
    # second stage: PMOS CS with NMOS mirror sink. y up -> z down
    n.M("M5", "z", "y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W5, Lp)
    n.M("M6", "z", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wsk"], Lb)
    # output inverter: z down -> vout high
    n.M("M7", "vout", "z", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp_inv"], 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "z", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn_inv"], 0.15)

    # ---- predictions ----
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i2)
    # first stage
    ido = itail / 2
    try:
        op1 = lut.op("n", p["Win"], Lin, 0.55, 0.6, vsb=0.3)
        gm1 = op1["gm"] * ido / max(op1["Id"], 1e-12)
    except Exception:
        gm1 = 18 * ido
    try:
        op5 = lut.op("p", W5, Lp, 0.85, 0.9)
        cg5 = op5["cgg"]
    except Exception:
        cg5 = W5 * Lp * 9e-15
    cy = cg5 * 1.5 + 3e-15
    # node z cap: inverter gates (with Miller) + drains
    cz = (p["Wn_inv"] + p["Wp_inv"]) * 0.15 * 1.2e-14 * 1.8 + 4e-15
    t1 = cy * 0.25 / itail            # slew of y over ~0.25 V
    t2 = cz * 0.9 / i2                # pull-down of z limited by sink current
    # inverter driving CL
    ion_p = 60e-6 * p["Wp_inv"]
    ion_n = 150e-6 * p["Wn_inv"]
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / min(ion_p, ion_n)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3 + 0.2e-9

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1, "offset": 1e-3}
